vc_ai_summaries.text: Reasonable to take a meeting. Ask which other boards your partner sits on.
Clean record with its own founders (0.07% of portfolio). One open DOJ probe into competing board seats, no charges.
On the evidence we could verify, a16z treats its own founders well: one founder-side lawsuit across about 1,456 portfolio companies, no lost cases or fraud findings, and a clean SEC record.

vc_ai_summaries.text: Bad events are measured as a share of the ~1,456 companies a16z has backed. Under 1% costs nothing. −3 per case the fund lost or where fraud was found.
Money 6 + media 6 (capped) + help after the check 5.5. Claims the fund makes about itself count at half until founders confirm them. Partner departures cost points.
Only first-hand accounts count. If negative accounts are under 1% of the portfolio, the fund gets its age default.
−1 per documented conflict, scaled by partner count. The section can't go below 0.
+1 for every 5 years of investing with no significant pattern of harm, up to +3.
Penalty only; a clean record earns 0. Open investigation −2. Shareholder suit against a partner as a public-company director −0.5 to −1.
